name: healthquery-connector
description: Read-only HealthQuery remote MCP connector with OAuth discovery and an explicit bearer-token fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Query self-hosted Health Connect data safely
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a deployed HealthQuery Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. OAuth discovery is preferred; an explicit read-only bearer credential is available as a separate fallback. The bundled skill requires schema discovery, read-only queries, and uncertainty-aware summaries without diagnosis.
defaultPrompt: Connect to HealthQuery and inspect my available health data types.
Summarize recent HealthQuery records, citing time range and missing data.
Use only read-only HealthQuery tools; do not diagnose or change data.
